title: Soft Starter
model_title: Soft Starter with Bypass Contactor (3-Phase Thyristor Control)

introduction.definition: A soft starter limits the starting current and torque of an AC motor. Anti-parallel thyristors in each phase pass only part of each half-cycle at first and the firing angle is advanced over the ramp until full voltage; a bypass contactor then closes. It does not control running speed.
applications: Pumps (reduces water hammer with soft stop)
Where supply capacity limits direct-on-line starting
key_points: Bypass contactor removes heat during running
Cheaper than a VFD; no speed control

classification.type: 3-phase controlled soft starter with internal bypass

introduction.summary: A soft starter reduces the starting current and torque shock of an AC motor. Anti-parallel thyristor (SCR) pairs in each phase let through only part of each half-cycle at first (reduced voltage); the firing angle is advanced over the ramp time until full voltage is reached, then a bypass contactor closes. Unlike a VFD, it does not change the running speed — only how the motor starts and stops.

script.narration: This module introduces the Soft Starter.
A soft starter limits the starting current and torque of an AC motor.
Anti-parallel thyristors in each phase pass only part of each half-cycle at first and the firing angle is advanced over the ramp until full voltage; a bypass contactor then closes.
It does not control running speed.
Typical applications include pumps (reduces water hammer with soft stop); fans and compressors; conveyors (avoids belt slip); where supply capacity limits direct-on-line starting.

script.narration: How the Soft Starter works.
At start, the thyristors fire late in each half-cycle — reduced voltage reaches the motor.
The control module advances the firing angle along the ramp; the motor accelerates smoothly.
Current transformers monitor current for current-limit and protection.
At full voltage the bypass contactor closes and carries the running current.
A soft stop reverses the ramp (useful against pump water hammer).
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
At start the thyristors fire late in each half-cycle, so only part of the sine wave reaches the motor (low voltage, low torque and current).

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Soft Starter.
Check fault log and temperatures.
Check terminal torque; clean heatsinks.
Inspect bypass contacts.
Watch for thyristor failure: phase loss / shorted SCR trip. Common cause: overload, too many starts, surge.
Watch for long start / stall: motor does not reach speed. Common cause: current limit too low for the load.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
